description: Ad Spend Watch — free read-only visibility for Google Ads™ (API v25): give your AI agent full read-only visibility into Google Ads: spend, performance, budgets, keywords, negatives, ads, audiences, conversions, assets, the native Google own recommendations, change history, account metadata (currency + test-vs-live) and shared-budget blast radius, plus a SELECT-only GAQL escape hatch. 22 reads, side_effects=none, zero writes — the agent can WATCH runaway spend (get_account_spend_today is the single number to guard) but cannot touch a cent. Egress allowlisted to the Google Ads + OAuth hosts only; credentials via BYOK vault, never logged. The paid companion Google Ads Airlock adds the 18 governed writes behind the RailCall airlock. Status: functional against API v25 with an offline contract test; pending live test-account proof. Independent product; NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google LLC. Google Ads is a trademark of Google LLC, used only to describe compatibility. BYOK. Quick start: railcall market install marcofgv/google-ads-watch, save the Google Ads credential in Studio then Integrations (developer_token + OAuth2 client_id/client_secret/refresh_token, or developer_token + access_token — both shapes declared in credential_spec), then run list_campaigns {account: 1234567890} for the account map and get_account_spend_today for the ceiling number. Who it is for: anyone letting an agent near an ad account — ops teams watching client spend, founders running their own ads, agent builders who need a safe read layer before earning write trust. Every command declares mode and risk (financial reads like get_spend, search_gaql and get_change_history are risk:medium; the rest low), the sandbox block declares no subprocess / no filesystem writes / Google hosts only, and get_change_history snaps to the native Google valid 7/14/30-day windows. Known limits: reads only (pausing a runaway needs Airlock), and production accounts need the native Google Basic Access on your developer token — test accounts work instantly.
